loopIdea: The closing beat pulls back out to the same macro of the sidewall bulge in the same studio-lit garage the opening pushed into, landing on that exact frame so a replay resumes the push-in.
mechanicTruth: A sidewall bulge is where the cords inside the tire tore loose, usually from a curb or pothole hit, so only air pressure is holding that spot out. A sidewall carries no repairable structure the way the tread does, so a patch or plug cannot restore it - the tire gets replaced.
